title: Portability: Claude and Codex capability shadow matrix
description: Objective: compare the two shipped provider capability surfaces without claiming an unshipped Codex execution edge. Exercise the real durable Claude construction/dispatch evidence and the public Codex observe/probe/render/reconcile surface, reporting exact PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN per capability and platform while performing no external provider launch.
definitionOfDone: A generated matrix covers Claude and Codex on every capability both actually publish, asserts a positive row count, and identifies each result as exact PASS, FAIL, or UNKNOWN with the production reason code/layer and evidence provenance.

Claude rows use the real daemon Foundation attempt/provider construction and durable reader surface; Codex rows use only the shipped public observe/probe/render/reconcile API, and the absent production Codex execution call site is reported UNKNOWN rather than mocked or called PASS.

One accepted construction/observation control exists for each provider, while missing runtime, hostile version/output, unsupported platform, unverifiable observation, and provider-surface disagreement pin their exact production code and layer.

The matrix launches no Claude or Codex subprocess and writes no provider, activation, or attempt authority; raw event/decision/process counts and relevant filesystem bytes/mtime are unchanged before and after every arm.
All rows bind to the same checkout source commit and canonical case digest, serialize deterministically, and run under plain Node/package roots with nonzero integration-test counts.
taskRails: Use only public package roots and the real production surface under test; no test helper may reimplement a projection, provider decision, transport handshake, or host adapter.
Every refusal/failure arm asserts the exact stable reason code and refusing layer; generated matrices assert a positive case count and include an accepted control so refusal-only suites cannot pass.
All fixtures and results are advisory/read-only: no imported state may activate, mutate durable authority, select a best tool, or perform cutover.
Use TDD and mutation-drill the production surface so a named assertion reddens; keep owned files focused and stage/commit only explicit paths.
Do not claim Codex execution portability: task-2159's published observation/probe/render/reconcile capability is the Codex subject until a separate production caller lands.
No external API calls, credentials, child processes, deep imports, or caller-forged runtime/provider truth; unsupported host evidence remains UNKNOWN.
Own only the provider matrix test and at most two focused fixture/helper files under tests/integration/portability.
reopenReason: Governor promotion under the human's standing unstall directive: worker-filed prerequisite (provider capability shadow matrix), BACKLOG was create_task default, not triage.
